title: Dark prompt, model menu, typed code, mark close
summary: A glowing mark drops into a dark frame and becomes a lockup, then one continuous camera pushes over a prompt bar: typing, a model menu pick, send, a spinner, a code window typing itself, which collapses back into the mark.
use_when: Launching an AI assistant or model picker where the prompt UI is the hero
A coding assistant that should show one request turn into code
Silent autoplay: the story reads from UI states alone, no VO
A dark, serif, restrained brand that wants one unbroken shot

look.type_style: book serif throughout, sentence case, normal tracking; opening lockup ~8 % H, greeting line ~4 % H, UI labels ~2.5 % H; code in the same serif at ~1.5 % H

sfx.event: model option click and send click

structure.shot: empty near-black frame; a small white glowing star mark falls in from the top edge and settles just left of centre
structure.motion: mark enters from above frame at 0.27-0.50, travels to centre by 1.00, springs.heavy ~20 fr (overshoot not measurable); slow drift down-left 1.00-2.00 (~2 % W); soft white glow halo around it

structure.shot: the wordmark (one word) appears to the right of the mark as a centred lockup with a wide glow, then shrinks and fades
structure.motion: wordmark reveals left to right in under 8 fr (±0.25 s); lockup holds big 2.27-2.50, scales down ~0.55x by 2.77 on easings.outExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s); slow shrink to 3.27; fades out 3.27-3.50, 8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: greeting line (5 words) with the accent-coloured mark above a rounded prompt bar: placeholder, plus button, model and effort selector, mic, send
structure.camera: push-in 1.00 -> 1.50 over 97 fr (bar width ~0.45 W -> 0.68 W), drifting right; easings.inOutSine
structure.motion: greeting and bar fade up together 3.77-4.27, 15 fr; a text caret slides in from the right at 6.00 and parks in the field by 6.50; placeholder fades at 6.77, 7 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the prompt field types a short request (5 words with an ellipsis); the send button lights in the accent colour at the first character
structure.camera: push-in continues ~1.50 -> 1.55, frame drifting right then up
structure.motion: Typewriter at ~13 chars/s, caret block; send button fills accent on the first keystroke (±0.25 s); request done at 8.77

structure.shot: a dropdown under the model selector opens: four model options with one-line descriptions and an effort row; a cursor hovers and picks the top option
structure.camera: dolly: pan left ~230 px/s @1920 at 8.77-9.27 to frame the menu, then up ~170 px/s at 9.50-9.77, hold; easings.inOutSine
structure.motion: menu grows down from the selector, springs.layout ~10 fr (±0.25 s); cursor enters from lower right at 9.27, cursor-path to the top option by 10.00, click at 11.00; menu fades 11.00-11.27, 7 fr; selector label swaps to the chosen option

structure.shot: cursor clicks send; the bar fades and a dotted spinner is left alone in the centre, grows, spins, shrinks away; then 1.2 s of empty dark
structure.camera: pull back to 1.00 on easings.inOutSine 15 fr as the UI fades (11.27-11.77); then static
structure.motion: send click squash at 11.27; UI fades 11.50-11.77; spinner scales 0.5 -> 1.0 by 12.50 (springs.ui), rotates constantly (easings.linear), holds to 13.27, scales down and dims 13.50-14.00, gone 14.27; empty 14.27-15.50

structure.shot: a tall portrait code window (traffic-light dots, centred title) grows in the middle and types a short script line by line in syntax colours
structure.motion: window scales 0.7 -> 1.0 15.50-16.00, springs.ui 15 fr (overshoot not measurable); code streams line by line from 16.50, ~3 lines/s, imports green, functions blue-violet, body near-white, keywords magenta; ~17 lines by 19.00

structure.shot: the code clears and the empty window outline collapses toward the centre into a tiny rectangle and disappears
structure.motion: code and dots fade at 19.27, 7 fr; outline shrinks 1.0 -> 0.3 by 19.77 then to 0 by 20.27, easings.inExpo ~30 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the star mark returns: large and soft grey, then small, white and crisp in the centre
structure.motion: mark appears at 20.50 at ~3x final size, blurred grey; shrinks and sharpens to final by 21.00, springs.snappy 15 fr (overshoot not measurable); holds still 21.00-22.27

structure.shot: the wordmark joins the mark as the closing lockup, no glow, held to the end
structure.motion: wordmark appears beside the mark within one cell (< 8 fr, ±0.25 s), lockup recentres; holds 60 fr to the last frame

params.brand: brand.json: serif display font, bg near-black, fg near-white, accent for the greeting mark and send button, logo mark + wordmark
params.content.greeting: one line above the prompt bar, about 5 words
params.content.models: 4 menu options, each a name and a one-line description
params.content.picked: index of the option the cursor picks (default 0)
params.content.effort: label of the effort row value
params.content.code: the script typed in the code window, 12-18 short lines
params.content.windowTitle: title in the code window bar

notes: Zero hard cuts: the whole film is one shot; rows split at state changes read from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). Camera moves only during the prompt section (3.77-11.77): push to ~1.5x then pans left and up to reveal the menu. Mark bookends the film (drop + lockup at the open, large-to-small settle + lockup at the close). Accent #D87755 sampled from the greeting mark pixels at 9.50 s, the rest from palettegen on keyframes 2.50 / 9.50 / 18.50 / 23.50. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed terms (not used as ids): model-menu-pick, collapse-to-mark, mark-scale-settle.
